chunks: This is what Allah's servant Ali, Commander of the Faithful, ordered Malik ibn al-Harith al-Ashtar in his instrument of appointment for him, when he appointed him governor of Egypt:
The collection of its land tax, fighting its enemies, improving its people, and cultivating its land.
ai.seo_question: What were the four main duties assigned to Malik al-Ashtar by Imam Ali upon his appointment as governor of Egypt?
ai.summary: This passage, often cited as the 'Treaty of Justice' in Shia political thought, outlines Imam Ali’s (AS) holistic governance model for Malik al-Ashtar, emphasizing that administrative efficiency is inseparable from moral integrity and divine accountability. The four duties—revenue collection, defense, social welfare, and infrastructure—reflect a comprehensive statecraft where the ruler acts as a shepherd responsible for both material prosperity and spiritual well-being of the subjects.
